title: Far West Contractors
description: Far West Contractors is a commercial construction company and general contractor headquartered in Placentia, California Founded in 2009, the company specializes in SCIF(Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities) construction projects for high-security facilities, as well as tenant improvements in the aerospace and defense industry. Their well-known project partners and clients include Boeing, Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), and Northrop Grumman [url=farwestcontractors.com]farwestcontractors.com[/url]
